src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Correct daily entry request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The details for correcting a recorded day; a stale version is refused rather than overwriting another admin's change.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Correct daily entry reply
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: What comes back after a daily entry is corrected.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: New egg grade request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The details needed to add an egg grade.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Daily entry lock result
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Holds the result of a day's entry being locked.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Daily entries for other modules
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lets other parts of the app look up daily egg entries.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Egg grades for other modules
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lets other parts of the app look up egg grades.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Starting egg grades
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lets farm setup create the first egg grades for a new account.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Egg sample data access
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lets the sample-data loaders read and write egg records; not available in the live system.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Egg module front door
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lists what other parts of the app can ask the egg side for, with the shapes of daily entries, grades, lots and movements.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Egg stock for sales
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lets sales check, reserve and take eggs from stock, and returns the lots it locked.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Locked daily entry
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Holds a daily entry that has just been locked.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Planned draw from a lot
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Holds how many eggs a sale plans to take from one egg lot.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Record daily entry request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The details for a day's egg counts by grade, deaths and other daily numbers.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Stock correction request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The details for writing off or recounting the eggs in one lot.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Stock correction result
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The correction as recorded plus the lot's new balance, so the screen can show it right away.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Refused entry lock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Holds a daily entry that could not be locked.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Sale stock plan
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Says whether stock covers a whole order and, if not, which grade fell short and by how much.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Eggs a sale needs
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: One line of a sale: its grade and how many eggs it needs.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Stock by grade
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Holds how many eggs are in stock for each grade.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Submit daily entry reply
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: What comes back after a daily entry is submitted.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Edit egg grade request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The details needed to change an egg grade.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Cancel daily entry request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: The details needed to cancel a submitted daily entry.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Cancel daily entry reply
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: What comes back after a daily entry is cancelled.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Correcting a daily entry
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Corrects a submitted day's counts and updates the egg stock and bird records to match.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Daily entry correction checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Checks a daily entry correction is valid before it is applied.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Condition grade rule
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Stops anyone typing a count for a condition grade by hand, since the daily entry's own counter fills it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Daily entry lookup
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Finds daily egg entries for other parts of the app.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Daily entry records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lists how daily entries are looked up and saved in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Locking old daily entries
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Locks submitted daily entries dated before the cutoff so they can no longer be edited freely.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Saving a daily entry
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Saves a day's egg counts by grade and other daily numbers as a draft.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Daily entry checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Checks a day's counts are valid before they are saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Submitting a daily entry
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Turns a day's egg counts into egg lots, one per grade, and records the day's deaths in the bird records.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Cancelling a daily entry
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Reverses a submitted day, emptying its egg lots and undoing its death count, but refuses if any of those eggs were sold.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Cancel daily entry checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Checks a daily entry cancellation comes with what it needs.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Adding an egg grade
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Adds a new egg grade, a bucket eggs are sorted into.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: New egg grade checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Checks a new egg grade's details are valid before it is added.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Low-stock level rule
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Decides who may set a low-stock warning level on an egg grade.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Egg grade lookup
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Finds egg grades for other parts of the app.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Egg grade records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Lists how egg grades are looked up and saved in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.name: Turn egg grade on or off
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/EggOpe.description: Switches an egg grade on or off without deleting it.
